criteria.text: Increase linear growth in achondroplasia with open epiphyses.
Patient is at least 5 years and under 18 years of age (approval criterion 1).
Prescribed by or in consultation with an endocrinologist or pediatric endocrinologist (approval criterion 2).
Achondroplasia confirmed by genetic testing with an identifiable FGFR3 gene mutation (approval criterion 3).
Body weight, growth velocity, height, and physical development will be measured at baseline and monitored throughout therapy (approval criterion 4).
Patient does not have closure of epiphyses (approval criterion 5).
No limb-lengthening surgery within the previous 18 months (approval criterion 6).
Patient will not receive limb-lengthening surgery (approval criterion 6).
Voxzogo is not prescribed concurrently with any human growth hormone product (denial criterion 2).
Voxzogo is not prescribed concurrently with an insulin-like growth factor (denial criterion 2).

Other causes of achondroplasia or short stature ruled out (e.g., malnutrition, hypothyroidism, hypercortisolism, hypochondroplasia, thanatophoric dysplasia, SADDAN syndrome, homozygous achondroplasia) (denial criterion 3).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Voxzogo (vosoritide) Criteria Version 1: Original 10/16/2022; Approval 11/18/2022; Effective 1/2/2023. Voxzogo is a C type natriuretic peptide (CNP) analog.
Encoded: closed indication, approval criteria 1-6 and denial criteria 1-3. Clinical documentation and monitoring commitments are attestations requiring manual review.
Accelerated approval based on improvement in annualized growth velocity. Continued approval may be contingent upon verification and description of clinical benefit in confirmatory trial(s).
Cautions (notes only): transient decreases in blood pressure have been reported. Monitor growth and adjust dosage according to body weight. Permanently discontinue upon closure of epiphyses.
Duration (notes only): initial approval 6 months; reauthorization 12 months with chart notes indicating improvements in annualized growth velocity AND height compared to pre-treatment baseline.

Quantity limits (notes only): 0.4 mg single-dose vial for reconstitution: 1 vial daily; 0.56 mg single-dose vial for reconstitution: 1 vial daily; 1.2 mg single-dose vial for reconstitution: 1 vial daily. Numeric quantity enforcement is not encoded.
Documentation verification, ongoing monitoring, duration, reauthorization response, quantity limits and cautions require manual review; this pack remains partial. No alternatives are specified.
